mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 0.5pp UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and depress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month compared to the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo vs previous 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a > 100k slowdown in PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced residential investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following a > 10% YoY decline in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth accelerates by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a strengthening manufacturing sector and increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a > 1% MoM acceleration in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) growth slows by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter, and the unemployment rate is above 6%, it signals a weakening consumer sector and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth slows > 1% QoQ and UNRATE > 6%
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances following a > 1% RSAFS slowdown and UNRATE > 6%.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% year-over-year, and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a potential inflationary surge that could prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a CPI > 3% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 2%.
